name: second-brain
description: A company-wide second brain: drop anything into raw/, a librarian agent builds a linked wiki, and every Claude session can use it

brain_path.title: Brain folder
brain_path.description: Where the brain lives on this computer (holds raw/ and wiki/). ~ means your user folder.

auto_ingest.title: Ingest automatically
auto_ingest.description: Process new files in raw/ in the background at session start and every few minutes. Off: you get a notice and run /brain-ingest yourself.
